caption: The drawing depicts two overlapping wrought iron objects positioned against a plain, light beige background. Each object consists of three elongated, flat legs that support a top element; the legs appear to taper to a point at the bottom and end in small outward-facing spiral or looped forms. The tops of the objects curve gently in a somewhat irregular manner, and both objects are rendered in shades of grey, with variations in shading to suggest metallic texture and dimensionality. The objects intersect at their supporting legs and are positioned side by side, creating a sense of depth and layered arrangement. The line work is precise and the overall composition focuses centrally on the entwined forms, with ample negative space surrounding the objects. There is a small signature or printed name in the lower left corner of the image.
title: Pot Trivets
